bg.$description: Base fill of the popup surface.

bg-image.$description: Optional image composited over the popup fill.

backdrop-filter.$description: Complete backdrop filter applied to the popup.

border.$description: Popup edge and the filter divider.

border-width.$description: Thickness of menu border and dividers.

gap.$description: Inline space between the parts of a row.

inline-padding.$description: Start and end inset of an action, group label, or filter.

min-inline-size.$description: Default minimum popup width, bounded by the viewport.

max-inline-size.$description: Maximum popup width, bounded by the viewport.

max-block-size.$description: Maximum popup height, bounded by the viewport.

font-family.$description: Family for action labels and the filter.

font-size.$description: Text size for action labels and the filter.

line-height.$description: Line height for action labels and the filter.

focus-width.$description: Width of a visible keyboard focus outline.

focus-color.$description: Color of a visible keyboard focus outline.

touch-target.$description: Minimum action and filter height for coarse pointers.

bg.$description: Background behind shortcut hints and the filter placeholder.

fg.$description: Foreground for shortcut hints and the filter placeholder.

font-size.$description: Size of metadata and group labels.

line-height.$description: Line height of metadata and group labels.

bg.$description: Background behind shortcut hints on a hovered or focused action.

fg.$description: Foreground for shortcut hints on a hovered or focused action.

padding.$description: Vertical inset used when an action wraps.

icon-size.$description: Size of an action glyph and the check indicator.

bg.$description: Background behind hovered or keyboard-focused actions.

fg.$description: Foreground for hovered or keyboard-focused actions.
